text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D8","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 20"}],"comment":"The ⌀20 diameter (D8) is the functional pin body of a stop pin and will mate with a hole, yet it carries no fit or tolerance callout. Without a defined fit the pin may not seat correctly or could be too loose to function as a positive stop. The designer should add an appropriate ISO fit or explicit tolerance band to D8.","recommended_correction":"Add a fit designation (e.g., h6, g6, or a locational fit per the application) or an explicit tolerance to dimension D8."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N5","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N5 specifies hardness but does not state whether heat treatment is to be performed before or after final machining. For a hardened stop pin this matters because machining after hardening requires different tooling and can affect dimensional accuracy. The designer should clarify the manufacturing sequence by stating the stage at which the heat treatment applies.","recommended_correction":"Update note N5 to explicitly state when heat treatment occurs relative to machining (e.g., 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 24-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING, BEFORE FINAL GRINDING')."}]}
